Baha update washington makati

Lulusong ka sa BAHA? Sana mabasa mo muna ito bago mo subukan.

1. Kung FI ang motor mo, alamin mo kung saan ang pwesto ng mga electronics mo. Tulad ng ECU (computer box), rectifier/regulator, speedo/panel at etc. Kung tingin mo aabutin, please wag mo na ituloy. Gastos malala yan.

2. Alamin kung nasaan ang airbox/air filter mo. Kung kasing taas yan ng baha. Wag mo na paandarin, itulak mo na lang. Malaki possibility na makahigop yan ng tubig at tumirik ka sa kalagitnaan.

3. Sumabay ka sa mas malaking sasakyan. Sundan mo kung saan dadaan ang gulong nila. Para kang nagkaroon ng bangka sa harapan na humahawi kahit papaano ng tubig para hindi siya ganun kalalim. Ingat lang sa mga sumasalubong na mga sasakyan din, pwede ka masemplang or tumumba sa impact ng tubig na dala nila.

4. Kung sakaling tumirik ang motor mo habang binabagtas mo yung baha. Wag mo ng subukan i-start pa at maaring nakalunok na yan ng tubig. Maaring masira ang mga pyesa ng makina mo kung ipipilit mo pa. Search sa google yung word na "hydrolock". Tulak mo na lang sa tabi at iwan motor mo, hanap ka rescue kung pwede. Kung wala kang tools para mai-drain yung tubig na nahigop ng makina better na 'wag mo na ipilit pa.

5. Para naman dun sa binaha habang nakaparada. Mga inabot ng tubig ang motor dahil sa taas ng tubig. Kung di talaga kayang itaas ang motor kahit tanggalin niyo lang po ang battery. After humupa ng baha, dalhin sa pinakamalapit na mekaniko para ma-check muna bago ibalik yung battery. Malaki ang chance na aandar yan basta naagapan.

6. Ano need mo i-check kung sakaling gusto mo ikaw gumawa ng motor mo? 
a. Drain lahat ng fluids (engine oil and gear oil, oil filter din kung meron)
b. Palit air filter (palitan, wag linisan lang, palit wag makulet!)
c. Check spark plug and spark plug cap (palitan if may budget)
d. Regrease lahat ng bearings (wheel bearings and etc.)

Ingat kayong lahat ngayong panahon ng tag-ulan.

👨‍🔧1: I-drain ang motor oil sa engine at gasoline sa fuel tank para hindi ito kalawangin.
👨‍🔧2: Patuyuin ang loob ng makina at fuel tank sa pamamagitan ng air compressor.
👨‍🔧3: Lagyan ng panibagong langis ang engine para lang mababad sa langis ang makina.
👨‍🔧4: Dalin ang motor sa pinaka-malapit na service center(casa o dealer) ng hindi papaandarin para pabugahan ng air compressor ang mga internal electronics parts nito para matuyo at upang maiwasan ang posibleng short circuit nito.

Marcos Jr., ITO ang TUNAY na state of the nation. Dalawang araw matapos ang SONA, pinapasinungalingan ng #CarinaPH ang mga salita ni Marcos.

Wala ni anino ni Marcos, Duterte, at ng kanilang flood control projects ang makita ngayong nasa state of calamity ang Metro Manila.

Nauna nang umalis ng bansa si VP Sara Duterte kaninang umaga kasama ang kaniyang pamilya papuntang Germany. Iniwan niya ang walo na patay, dalawang sugatan, isang nawawala sa Northern Mindanao, at 866,483 na pamilyang apektado dahil sa bagyo. Kalakhan ng apektado ay mga maralitang lungsod, manggagawa, magsasaka, at mangingisda. Ang pinsala sa agrikultura ay nasa P8.7 million at pinsala sa imprastraktura ay umabot na sa P700,000.

Ipinagmalaki ni Marcos ang di umanong natapos na 5,500 flood control projects sa kanyang State of the Nation Address (SONA) noong isang araw ngunit pareho pa rin ang dinaranas ng mamamayang Pilipino: lubog sa baha, nasa panganib, at kanya-kanyang paraan para iligtas ang sarili. Ang ganitong mga proyekto ay kadalasan pang balon ng korapsyon at hindi komprehensibong tinutugunan ang climate change.

Ang pagtindi ng pagbaha ay idinulot ng walang pagkukubling pagbebenta ni Marcos ng mga lupain, kabundukan, at dagat ng Pilipinas. Isa na rito sa porma ng malawakang reclamation projects na sumisira sa ating kalikasan tulad na lamang ng Manila Bay Reclamation project.

Dapat managot ang rehimeng Marcos sa kriminal na kapabayaan nito at lantarang paglulustay ng pera ng bayan para sa ganansya ng mga kapitalista at dayuhan. Simbolo ang pag-alis ni Sara Duterte papuntang Germany at kawalang aksyon ng rehimeng Marcos sa gitna ng sakuna na hindi kailanman sila tunay na nagsisilbi sa bayan, kundi para lang sa kanilang sarili at mga imperyalistang amo.

Nananawagan kami sa kabataang Pilipino na mag-ingat at maging mapagmatyag. Kasabay nito, ilantad natin ang pabayang rehimeng Marcos sa pagwawalang-bahala nito sa kaligtasan ng mamamayan alang-alang sa kita ng iilan.

Flooded Car? Here's what to do:

1. Immediately disconnect the negative cable of your car battery to avoid any possible short circuit. This is also to protect the ECU or computer box from damage.

2. Do not start the engine. Try to push the car out to higher ground or try jacking it with the car jack.

3. Disengage and release the parking brake. Keep the transmission in 1st gear (for manual transmission) or "P" (for automatic transmission) to prevent the brake canvas from sticking. This is even more important for cars that use drum brakes.

4. Take plenty of photos both inside and outside the car to document any damage or how deep the car was underwater. This will be useful for both the Insurance and/or Professional Mechanic to determine the extent of the damage.

5. Wait at least 24 hours before you do anything to the vehicle, giving it time to drain, if not completely dry out.

6. If the water got so deep that the dashboard was covered, do not try to start it at all. If any liquid is in the cylinders it will cause damage to the engine. Most of the electronics in the car would have been submerged at this depth, as well.

7. If you don’t think the water got that high, it’s still best to take a look at the oil dipstick to see if there are any traces of water in the lubrication system. If so, assume the engine is flooded and don’t try to start it.

8. You’re in better shape if the water stayed below the center line of your wheels. Nevertheless, let the interior air out as much as possible before trying to start it, taking out the floor mats, trunk mat and even the seats. Much of the wiring and some of the computers in today’s cars are located under the carpet and console box, so even if the engine compartment was not inundated, you could still experience faults to secondary systems.

9. When in doubt, either have your vehicle towed to your trusted service center or call your professional mechanic/electrician for a more thorough inspection and assessment.

🌂 Leptospirosis is a disease caused by Leptospira bacteria. Infected animals spread the bacteria through their urine (pee). When infected animals pee, the bacteria get into the water or soil and can live there for weeks to months.

🌂 You can be infected if you touch fresh water, soil, or other objects contaminated with infected animal urine. The most common ways to get infected is urine or contaminated water getting in your eyes, nose, mouth, or broken skin (such as a cut or scratch). You can also get infected by eating contaminated food or drinking water.

🌂 Some people with leptospirosis do not have any symptoms. When symptoms occur, they can include fever, headache, chills, muscle aches, vomiting, jaundice (yellow eyes and skin), red eyes, stomach pain, diarrhea, and sometimes a rash. 

🌂 Without proper treatment with antibiotics, people with leptospirosis may develop serious problems with their kidneys, liver, or lining of the brain and spinal cord. In some cases, leptospirosis can cause death.

𝙒𝙃𝙊 𝙄𝙎 𝘼𝙏 𝙍𝙄𝙎𝙆?
✔️ Visit flooded or recently flooded areas
✔️ Swim, wade, kayak, or raft in potentially contaminated fresh water like lakes and rivers
✔️ Visit urban areas with poor sanitation
✔️ Touch animals or their body fluids. Animals that can be infected are mammals, including rodents, cows, sheep/goats, pigs, horses, dogs, and wildlife.

Flooded Car? Here's what to do:

1. Immediately disconnect the negative cable of your car battery to avoid any possible short circuit. This is also to protect the ECU or computer box from damage.

2. Do not start the engine. Try to push the car out to higher ground or try jacking it with the car jack.

3. Disengage and release the parking brake. Keep the transmission in 1st gear (for manual transmission) or "P" (for automatic transmission) to prevent the brake canvas from sticking. This is even more important for cars that use drum brakes.

4. Take plenty of photos both inside and outside the car to document any damage or how deep the car was underwater. This will be useful for both the Insurance and/or Professional Mechanic to determine the extent of the damage.

5. Wait at least 24 hours before you do anything to the vehicle, giving it time to drain, if not completely dry out.

6. If the water got so deep that the dashboard was covered, do not try to start it at all. If any liquid is in the cylinders it will cause damage to the engine. Most of the electronics in the car would have been submerged at this depth, as well.

7. If you don’t think the water got that high, it’s still best to take a look at the oil dipstick to see if there are any traces of water in the lubrication system. If so, assume the engine is flooded and don’t try to start it.

8. You’re in better shape if the water stayed below the center line of your wheels. Nevertheless, let the interior air out as much as possible before trying to start it, taking out the floor mats, trunk mat and even the seats. Much of the wiring and some of the computers in today’s cars are located under the carpet and console box, so even if the engine compartment was not inundated, you could still experience faults to secondary systems.

9. When in doubt, either have your vehicle towed to your trusted service center or call your professional mechanic/electrician for a more thorough inspection and assessment.

Sinabi ng mga senador na naniniwala sila na ang reclamation project sa Manila Bay ang naging sanhi ng baha hanggang tuhod sa labas ng Senado sa Lungsod ng Pasay noong Miyerkules.

Sa isang text message sa mga mamamahayag, sinabi ng dating Senate President Juan Miguel Zubiri na naniniwala siyang ang reclamation ay isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit binaha ang bahagi ng Diokno Boulevard.

“This, I believe, is the consequence of all the reclamation happening in Manila Bay, wala ng malabasan na flood water dito sa Pasay at Manila,” ayon kay Zubiri

“Babaha at babaha na palagi dyan sa atin tuwing uulan nang malakas,” dagdag niya.

Sinisi rin ni Sen. Joel Villanueva ang reclamation project para sa malawakang pagbaha sa Bulacan, ang kanyang bayan.

“Reclamation pa more!” ayon sa kanyang mensahe sa mga mamamahayag.

Matatandaang naging mainit na balita sa panahon ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte ang pag-apruba niya sa mga reclamation projects sa Manila Bay. 

Noong taong 2023, napagpasyahan ng gobyerno ni Pangulong Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. na suspendihin ang lahat ng 22 Manila Bay reclamation projects na na naaprubahan sa panahon ni Duterte.

#FloodedVehicleTips

Nakapagrestore na po kami ng flooded vehicles nung ondoy at habagat, kalahating lubog at todo lubog, narerestore pero masalimuot at magastos po sa mga aabutan po ng baha at di mailikas sa higher ground.  Itong BRV todo lubog po yan umabot ng p250k ginastos ng client inorder namin pyesa surplus at sa casa. Yung computer box ni BRV di namin pinalitan nagsurvive.

Sana makatulong itong mga susunod kung Wala kayong insurance acts of nature.

1. Disconnect battery - Kung matatanggal nyo both terminal sa battery tanggalin nyo po bago pa tuluyan tumaas ang floods. 10 or 12 na wrench  kailangan nyo sa stock battery terminal. Kung Wala kayo tools bunutin nyo master fuse sa fuse box

2.  Don't Start your vehicle - Pagkahupa ng baha, hwag na hwag nyo susubukan istart ang sasakyan.  Hindi po Yan tinapa na pwde na kainin agad 😮🤪😭. Pag inistart nyo na damp pa electronics, short circuit ang resulta. At kung nakinig kayo sa amin,  may chance na maaring makuha sa thorough electronics cleaning mga components by a professional or experienced mechanic. Hindi na papalitan.  Tyagaan ang paglinis nyan Isa Isa and test individually.  Also baka mag hydrolock ang engine pwde bumaluktot or magbend ang connecting rods Wala na game over overhaul na makina.

3.  Mga computer box ng vehicles from. Around  2008 onwards sealed and NASA engine bay na sealed in most cases it will survive the floods Basta hwag istart until malinis lahat. Yung ibang critical components hindi sealed at  maaring mag cause ng failure to start engine Kasi flood damaged  like instrumentation panel, throttle position sensor, mass air flow sensor, electric power steering module, Aircon module, electric power steering motor, airbag module, immobilizer module so need malinis or replace if damaged na even after cleaning 

4.  Hubad -Depende sa level ng baha kung Todo lubog eh hubad lahat ng components ng sasakyan Kasi bobombahin Yan ng pressure washer and steam cleaner. Kung kalahating lubog kalas dashboard carpet upuan sidings para malinis pati wiring harness and connectors  Need kalasin Yan Kasi putik Yan pag natuyo may cause rust at Amoy kanal saskyan nyo. All exposed metal structure like safety beam sa ilalim ng dashboard na walang paint need pahiran ng light coat ng oil para madeter ang rust

5. Towing - asahan nyo bukas pahirapan. Ang typical towing rate b4 typhoon Karina nasa  p3K MManila and p4K Rizal expect na tataas Yan. Law of supply and demand.

“The intense flooding we are now experiencing in Metro Manila, Bulacan, Cavite and Bataan is a direct result of the massive reclamation in Manila Bay,” pahayag ni Kalikasan Advocacy Officer at AKAP KA Manila Bay spokesperson Jonila Castro.

Matapos ang serye ng matinding tag-init, nakararanas naman ngayon ng malawakang pagbaha ang Metro Manila, Bulacan, Cavite, at Bataan na dulot ng pagpasok ng Bagyong Carina sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) nitong Lunes, Hulyo 22. 

Kung babalikan ang kalilipas lamang na State of the Nation Address ni Marcos Jr., nangako lamang ito ng pagpapatayo ng “mahahalagang imprastruktura” upang aniya’y magsilbing proteksyon at sentro ng koordinasyon sa paghahatid-tulong. Gayundin ay ang kaniyang pagpupursigi pa sa proyektong reklamasyon sa Pampanga Bay at Cagayan de Oro River na umano’y magsisilbing dagdag lunas sa mga pagbaha. 

Mula pa man 2014, ilang grupo na ng mga eksperto at environmental defenders ang nagpahayag ng pagtutol sa mga proyektong reklamasyon ni dating pangulong Duterte dahil magdudulot ito ng matinding pagbaha gawa ng pagtaas ng sea levels at/o paglubog ng lupa.

Ayon pa sa Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazard (NOAH) project, ang pangunahing programa sa disaster risk reduction and management ng bansa, ang mga coastal erya gaya ng komunidad ng Manila Bay ay lubhang bulnerable sa pagbaha, kung kaya’t delikado ang proyektong reklamasyon at dredging sa mga komunidad gaya nito.

Sa kabila ng mga datos na inilahad ng syensya at pagtutol ng mga residente sa paligid ng Manila Bay, matibay na pinanindigan ni Duterte ang pagpapahintulot sa 2,500 ektaryang proyekto ng kaniyang kroni na San Miguel Corporation (SMC) sa reklamasyon at dredging projects sa Manila Bay. Mayroon pa itong 23 ongoing projects sa 47,000 ektarya na sumisira sa mga likas na yamang tubig at lupa na pumoprotekta sa komunidad mula sa storm surges, pagbaha, at coastal erosions o tuluyang pagguho ng baybayin.

Ganito ang sitwasyon sa Taliptip sa bayan ng Bulakan, Bulacan, na sentro ng malaking reklamasyon ng SMC kung saan ginagawa ang New Manila International Airport na bahagi ng Bulacan Aerotropolis ni Ramon Ang.

Ayon sa mga residente, mula nang magsimula ang proyektong ito ay malaki ang naging perwisyo nito sa kanila lalo sa tuwing tatamaan ng bagyo ang lugar. Nariyan ang mabilis na pagtaas ng tubig, mabagal na paghupa ng baha, at umaabot na sa leeg ng tao ang lebel ng tubig kapag may bagyo.

Ganito rin ang kalagayan sa Navotas kung saan mayroong 650-ektaryang Navotas Bay Reclamation project ang SMC at Navotas LGU. Batid ng mga residenteng mangingisda na may malaking kinalaman ang proyektong ito kung bakit mas matindi ang pagbaha sa Navotas at buong National Capital Region. 

Habang sa CAMANAVA naman, bagamat Signal No. 1 pa lamang kaninang umaga ng Hulyo 24, ay may malawakan nang pagbaha. Anang Bayan Muna Partylist CAMANAVA, na ang paglala ng mga natural disaster nitong mga nagdaang taon ang bunga ng krisis sa klima buhat ng mabilisang pagkalala ng panahon at pagbago ng  temperatura sa buong daigdig.

Lahat ng ito ay sa kabila ng isinaad ni Marcos Jr. sa kaniyang SONA na sa nagdaang dalawang taon ay nakapagtapos ang kaniyang termino ng 5,500 flood control projects.

“From Presidents Duterte to Marcos Jr., lie upon lie has been rained upon us on the so-called benefits of reclamation. And now, only two days after President Marcos Jr.’s State of the Nation Address where he proudly committed himself as a climate champion, all his empty promises are literally drowning homes and families around Manila Bay,” ani Castro.

Sa karagdagan, sa pinuntahang Board of Fund meeting ni Marcos Jr. noong Hulyo 9-12 sa Songdo, South Korea, nakuha ng Pilipinas ang hosting bid sa Loss and Damage Fund (LDF) na isang piskal na mekanismo upang suportahan ang mga developed at developing countries na lubhang naaapektuhan ng climate change.

Ani Lidy Nacpil, coordinator ng Asian Peoples' Movement on Debt and Development (APMDD), nakasalalay na sa Pilipinas bilang host ng LDF kung paano nito ipapamalas ang pamumuno habang bahagi ng Board ng Fund. Dagdag pa ni Nacpil, nararapat na singilin at managot ang mga developed countries sa kanilang “historical, legal, and moral obligation to provide reparations for climate devastation.”

Ayon naman sa isang independent research group na Climate Change Tracker, mula 2022, ang China at United States ang may pinakamalaking ambag sa greenhouse gas emissions (GHG) at pandaigdigang polusyon mula sa naglalakihang kumpanyang gumagamit ng fossil fuel, chemical waste ng mga plantation, at military waste na nagkokontrol sa pagtaas-baba ng temperaturang salik sa krisis sa klima.

“Our experience with Typhoon Carina is showing us that reclamation is a huge lie perpetuated by big business and their partners in government! These projects are not solutions but massive problems. Reclamation projects cause severe flooding and destroy the homes and livelihoods of the people. Those behind these projects must be held accountable,” anang Castro. “Their negligence and disregard for the environment and the welfare of the people must be brought to justice. We will no longer tolerate the continuous destruction of our environment and the exploitation of our communities!,” dagdag pa niya.

Samantala, nakatakdang umalis ng PAR ang bagyo sa Huwebes, Hulyo 25, ngunit mararamdaman ang malakas na ulang dulot nito hanggang Biyernes. Matindi na rin agad ang pinsalang naidulot nito at mas pinalakas ng hanging Habagat sa mga lugar sa Central Luzon at Mindanao kung saan may mga naitalang landslides, at malalaking bilang ng mga pinalilikas. Dagdag pa rito ang pagpapakawala ng ilang mga dam ng tubig kasabay ng pagtaas ng tubig sa mga ilog at look. 

Sa kasalukuyan, idineklara na ng Metro Manila Council (MMC) ang NCR na nasa ilalim ng State of Calamity dahil sa walang tigil na pag-ulan mula noong Lunes. Umabot na rin sa 20.6 meters ang tubig sa Marikina River habang ang La Mesa dam sa Bulacan ay nasa critical level na rin at ang overflowing nito ay nakakaapekto sa mga kalapit na lugar na Quezon City, Valenzuela, at Malabon.

🌧️🚨 Important Update: Typhoon Carina & Hanging Habagat Flood Advisory 🚨🌧️

Dear WE AIM OFW INC Community,

Typhoon Carina, combined with the Hanging Habagat, has caused significant flooding in various areas. We are deeply concerned for the safety and well-being of everyone affected. Please take note of the following safety measures to protect yourself and your loved ones during this challenging time:

🚨 Before the Flood:
1.) Stay Informed: Keep updated with the latest weather reports and advisories from official sources like PAGASA and local government units.
2.) Emergency Kit: Prepare an emergency kit with essentials such as water, non-perishable food, medicines, flashlight, batteries, and important documents.
3.) Evacuation Plan: Know the nearest evacuation centers and routes. Plan how to reach them quickly if necessary.
4.) Home Preparation: Secure your home by sealing cracks, ensuring proper drainage, and moving valuables to higher ground.
5.) Turn Off Utilities: Familiarize yourself with the locations of your main switches for gas, electricity, and water.

🌊 During the Flood:
1.) Stay Indoors: If safe, stay inside your home and move to higher floors if necessary. Avoid floodwaters at all costs.
2.) Follow Instructions: Adhere to the advice and instructions given by local authorities and emergency services.
3.) Emergency Kit: Keep your emergency kit within reach and ensure all family members know its location.
4.) Stay Connected: Ensure your mobile phones are fully charged and have backup power sources to stay in touch with family and emergency services.
5.) Avoid Floodwaters: Do not walk or drive through floodwaters as they may be deeper and more dangerous than they appear.

⚠️ After the Flood:
1.) Wait for Clearance: Only return to your home once authorities have declared it safe to do so.
2.) Inspect Your Home: Check for structural damage before entering. Ensure that there are no electrical hazards.
3.) Sanitation: Avoid contact with floodwaters as they may be contaminated. Clean and disinfect everything that got wet.
4.) Health Precautions: Seek medical attention if you have any health concerns or injuries. Be aware of potential waterborne diseases.
5.) Document Damage: Take photos of any damage for insurance claims and assistance applications.

Our thoughts and prayers are with everyone affected by the flooding.

Narito ang ilang mga tips ngayon panahon ng Bagyo: ☔

🌧️ Alamin ang mga karaniwang panganib at epekto ng bagyo. Basahin ang mga paalala at impormasyon mula sa lokal na pamahalaan at meteorological agency. Kilalanin din ang mga lugar na malapit sa inyong tahanan na madalas na binabaha o naapektuhan ng bagyo.

🌧️ Paghahanda ng Emergency Kit: Ihanda ang isang emergency kit na maglalaman ng mga essentials tulad ng pagkain na hindi naluluma, tubig, medikal na kagamitan, mga kandila, flashlights, baterya, at mga pangunahing kasangkapan.

🌧️ Mga Pamilya at Komunidad: Magplano ng maayos sa pamilya kung saan pupunta o kung paano magkakasama sa isang mas ligtas na lugar. Makipag-ugnayan din sa mga kapitbahay o komunidad upang magtulungan sa panahon ng krisis.

🌧️ Pag-secure ng Tahanan: Siguraduhin na ang inyong tahanan ay maayos na naka-secure. I-check ang mga bintana, pinto, at bubong kung sila ay naka-seal ng maayos. Takpan ang ano mang mga butas na magcause ng tulo sa loob ng bahay.

🌧️ Paghanda ng Mataas na Lugar: Kung sakaling kayo ay nasa lugar na madalas na binabaha, maghanda ng plano kung paano kayo makakalikas at saan pupunta upang maiwasan ang peligro.

🌧️ Magkaroon ng Backup Power Source: Ang bagyo ay maaaring magdulot ng pagkawala ng kuryente. Magkaroon ng backup na power source tulad ng powerbank, generator o mga portable na solar panels.

🌧️ Makinig sa mga abiso. Maging handa na sumunod sa mga abiso at paalala ng lokal na pamahalaan at mga awtoridad. Iwasan ang paglalakad o pagmamaneho sa baha o malalim na tubig.

🌧️ Kung wala naman mahalagang pupuntahan, manatili na lamang sa bahay. Upang maiwasan ang anumang aksidente o pagkakasakit dulot ng ulan.

Ang paghahanda sa bagyo ay napakahalaga upang maprotektahan ang sarili at ang pamilya mula sa mga potensyal na panganib. Dapat maging handa sa anumang sitwasyon at magtulungan bilang isang komunidad upang masiguro ang kaligtasan ng lahat. 🥰

Keep safe everyone ❤️

Ok po ba sa network na yung 5 araw ko sa mga meeting icacancel ko po at ipapalit ko ang 5 araw ng Live?

Pero! Parang pandemic style po ito.. naalala nyo ang pandemic didiretso lang live ko walang pinapaship na item? Saka lang pinaship after Matanggal ang Lockdown?

Dito po maglilive lang ako ng diretso.. METRO MANILA BUYERS WAG KAYONG AASANG KINABUKASAN MADEDELIVER NA AGAD. Kasi po ayoko kong isugal ang mga rider ko sa baha, sakit o ano mang kapahamakan.. ibig kong sabihin...

Maglilive po ako pero kapag ok na panahon saka po namin ipapacod sa Metro Manila kapag ok na panahon.

Connect din po kasi dyan ang Provincial Area.
Bayad muna kayo after 2weeks saka nyo matatanggap magkakaroon po ito ng delay dahil sa panahon sigurado hindi rin po makakapagdeliver yan sa bawat area.

Inshort ang papasukin lang naming buyer ay willing to wait! Maige po sa ganitong systema nagkakaliwanagan ang lahat bago ako bumira ng Live. Ang iba po kasi dito makapagantay lang ng 2weeks o 3weeks kala mo lalagnatin na..

Pasabugin ko bahay nyan malalaman nila gaano kabagsik ang binilhan nyo ng alahas.

Kaya kung matatapang po mga receiver nyo taena ipaalam nyo din kagaano katapang ang binilhan nyo ng mga alahas! Baka isipin nilang porket seller ako e d ako papalag shuta d ako mabait tropa!

"Labanan ang Banta ng Baha sa Pangasinan: Pirmahan ng MOU sa Proyektong SAIL!"

Handa nang lagdaan ni Governor Ramon V. Guico III ang Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) kasama ang Center for Disaster Preparedness (CDPFI) upang labanan ang peligro ng baha sa Pangasinan. Ito ay para sa pagpapatupad ng 'Scaling Across Integrated Risk Management at National and Local Levels (SAIL) Project.'

Pinagtibay ito matapos na aprubahan ng Provincial Board na pinamumunuan ni Vice Governor Mark Ronald DG. Lambino sa regular na sesyon noong Hulyo 24, ang resolusyon na nagtatalaga sa pagtutulungan ng probinsyal na pamahalaan at ng CDPFI.

Ayon sa inaprubahang resolusyon, napili ng CDPFI ang probinsya bilang estratehikong simula upang ipakilala ang ridge-to-reef approach sa disaster risk reduction and management.

Ang iskedyul ng mga aktibidad para sa pagpapatupad ng proyekto ay mula Oktubre 2022 hanggang Setyembre 2025.

Sawa na ako sa air-conditioned taxi cabs or buses,

Gusto ko namang maging MALAYA.

Ang maging kaparte ng mundo.

1 DEAD, 2 HURT AS TYPHOON #EgayPH RIPS THROUGH LUZON – NDRRMC

Typhoon Egay has reportedly left one person dead and triggered flooding and landslides in several parts of the country, the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) said.
In its situational report issued on Wednesday, July 26, the NDRRMC said one fatality was reported in Calabarzon while two others were injured in Calabarzon and Western Visayas.

The agency also recorded 58 flooding incidents in five regions and 16 landslides induced by heavy rains.

The NDRRMC said a total of 44,356 families or equivalent to 180,439 were affected by the typhoon. Around 11,041 people are staying in 107 evacuation centers.

Typhoon Egay ripped through northern Luzon, dumping heavy rains, knocking out power supply and toppling trees and other structures.
Several areas in Cagayan were also inundated with floodwaters after Egay made landfall – first in Fuga Island in Aparri on Tuesday night and second in Dalupiri Island on Wednesday morning.
Egay is forecast to weaken in the following hours as it heads out of the Philippine area of responsibility. – rrd

Author Nick Thompson recognizes that pride is our worst enemy. If pride is our chief foe, then humility is our chief friend, even though its company may be painful. Defining humility as “the downward disposition of a Godward self-perception,” Thompson walks us through the practical implications of this definition, leading us to embrace a God-centered perspective on the self. Endorsements
“Christians can become lopsided, leaning towards either how to think, live, or feel better. Thompson’s teaching on humility teaches us to view ourselves more accurately and realistically, affecting every aspect of our lives. His impressive breadth of application makes his teaching concrete rather than abstract. This book establishes the right way of thinking and living in light of who God is and who we are. What more could one want in any book on theology, or on Christian living?” — Ryan M. McGraw, Morton H. Smith Professor of Systematic Theology, Greenville Presbyterian Theological Seminary

“When I was a child, my mother used to tell a fable about a man who won a medal for humility but had it taken away the moment he wore it. The point was obvious and has been proven by time: we are never as humble as we ought to be, nor even as humble as we wish to be. Yet by God's grace we can be humbler than we are right now, and it's for that reason that I recommend Growing Downward, a book that mines the Scriptures to show how to display a humility that is empowered by Christ and  exalts the name of Christ.” — Tim Challies

“Growing Downward is the most robust, biblical, theological discussion of humility I’ve seen. Nick roots the discussion exactly where it needs to begin—with a theology of God. He defines humility as ‘the downward disposition of a Godward self-perception.’ Humility happens when we see ourselves in light of the grandeur and grace of God. There is nothing trite about this book. It is a mini theology, covering topics from the character of God to the nature of sin, anthropology, Christology, soteriology, ecclesiology, and eschatology—all of it pointing to the magnificent glory of God and the joy of true humility before Him. The benefit of this book is that it doesn’t merely talk about humility; it actively helps readers experience humility as they are brought before the truth of God. While the material is weighty, Nick uses personal illustrations, stories, and notes that keep it moving along. But this is not a book to be read quickly. The truths are too deep. It would make for a great small group Bible study. Highly recommend!” — Dale VanDyke, senior pastor, Harvest Orthodox Presbyterian Church, Wyoming, Michigan

“Defining humility as ‘the downward disposition of a Godward, Christ-centered self-perception’ in view of so much misconception, Thompson shows how relentlessly biblical the implications of this definition are for the life of the believer. Doctrinally penetrating, consistently pastoral, and highly readable, Growing Downward is as edifying as it is deeply searching.” — Richard B. Gaffin Jr., professor of biblical and systematic theology, emeritus, Westminster Theological Seminary

“Among the most significant characteristics that believers ought to seek in a world inundated with pride and arrogance is true humility. But what is humility, and how does a Christian come to embody it? In Growing Downward: The Path of Christ-Exalting Humility, Nick Thompson walks through the biblical and redemptive-historical teaching about humility, encouraging believers to understand what it is and how to possess it. Rooting his teaching in biblical anthropology and Christology, Thompson helps us understand better the reasons we should pursue humility, how Christ is the source and example of it, and how we can grow in it. If you are looking to read a theologically rich and spiritually edifying book, look no further.”  — Nick Batzig, pastor of Church Creek PCA in Charleston, South Carolina, and associate editor, Ligonier Ministries

“In this much-needed, well-written, easy-to-read book on a critical subject for every Christian, Nick Thompson reminds us that real humility springs from knowing God and ourselves as both truly are. His book is a model of how theology should be applied to practical Christian living. He offers no manual on how to act humbly but provides biblical motivations to be humble. May God use this essential book in all of our lives so that we may genuinely confess with John the Baptist, ‘[Christ] must increase, and I must decrease.’”   — Joel R. Typhoon Egay has reportedly left one person dead and triggered flooding and landslides in several parts of the country, the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) said.
 
In its situational report issued on Wednesday, July 26, the NDRRMC said one fatality was reported in Calabarzon while two others were injured in Calabarzon and Western Visayas.
 
The agency also recorded 58 flooding incidents in five regions and 16 landslides induced by heavy rains.
 
The NDRRMC said a total of 44,356 families or equivalent to 180,439 were affected by the typhoon. Around 11,041 people are staying in 107 evacuation centers.
 
Typhoon Egay ripped through northern Luzon, dumping heavy rains, knocking out power supply and toppling trees and other structures.
 
Several areas in Cagayan were also inundated with floodwaters after Egay made landfall – first in Fuga Island in Aparri on Tuesday night and second in Dalupiri Island on Wednesday morning.
 
Egay is forecast to weaken in the following hours as it heads out of the Philippine area of responsibility. – rrd

postText:
Today, 26th of July, we commemorate the Internationa Day for the Conservation of Mangroves Ecosystem.   

According to Dr. Jurgenne Primavera,  Philippines' leading scientist and expert on Mangroves, "The Philippines harbour 39 species of true mangroves belonging to the following genera: Acanthus, Camptostemon, Lumnitzera, Excoecaria, Pemphis, Xylocarpus, Aegiceras, Osbornia, Nypa, Aegialitis, Bruguiera, Ceriops, Kandelia, Rhizophora, Scyphiphora, and Sonneratia." 

Its ecosystem services range from food such as fish and shrimp, other species collected from mangroves are crabs and lobsters, bivalve and gastropod molluscs, and other invertebrates. Other services include coastal protection, erosion control, sediment stabilization, flood regulation, nutrient supply and regeneration, waste treatment, and wildlife habitats.  

The decline of mangroves from about 500,000 ha in 1918 to only 120,500 ha in 1994 was caused by overexploitation caused by coastal land conversions to human settlements, agriculture, aquaculture, salt pans, and industry.

An environmental health organization has renewed its call for ecological solid waste management (ESWM) following the flash floods that recently inundated parts of Metro Manila.

The EcoWaste Coalition repeated its public appeal for waste prevention and reduction as floodwater caused by heavy monsoon rains submerged a number of streets in the metropolis affecting scores of commuters, residents and even those lining up for COVID-19 vaccine.

“We all know that Metro Manila is vulnerable to flooding due to its inherent geographical characteristics that are aggravated by other factors such as the recklessly thrown garbage clogging up the inadequate urban drainage system,” said Jove Benosa, Zero Waste Campaigner, EcoWaste Coalition.

According to government data, the region's 17 local government units (LGUs) generate close to 10,000 tons of trash every day.  Over 30 truckloads of garbage are collected from the 57 pumping stations operating all over the region, according to the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA). 

“While we cannot do much to alter the region’s geography, we can surely help in mitigating the floods by preventing plastics and other discards, including COVID-related waste such as used face masks, from spilling into the storm drains and waterways,” Benosa said.

The strict observance of Republic Act 9003, or the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act, in every household and community will avoid garbage from being produced, littered and dumped in streets, vacant lots, esteros and rivers, the group said. 

R.A. 9003, the country’s waste law enacted in 2000, promotes waste avoidance and volume reduction, segregation at source, reusing, recycling, composting and other best practices in ESWM excluding incineration

“The honest-to-goodness implementation of waste separation at source, recycling, reusing and composting will not only mitigate flooding woes, but also curb leptospirosis, dengue and other water-borne diseases during the rainy season,” Benosa said.
 
“LGUs should determinedly enforce the salient provisions of R.A. 9003, including penalizing those who recklessly throw their trash anywhere without any sense of guilt or shame,” he added. 
R.A. 9003 explicitly bans the dumping of waste materials in streets, canals, esteros and other public places and penalizes such environmental offenses with a fine of P300 to P1,000, or one to 15-day community service, or both.

Meanwhile, the EcoWaste Coalition appealed to the National Solid Waste Management Commission (NSWMC) to issue the list of non-environmentally acceptable products and packaging (NEAPP) materials as required by R.A. 9003 to address mounting waste and pollution in the country.

Stakeholders led by Oceana Philippines last month sued the NSWMC to compel it to perform its task of issuing the NEAPP list, saying  “it was time to interpose and seek legal action on this issue.”

Flooded Car? Here's what to do:

1. Immediately disconnect the negative cable of your car battery to avoid any possible short circuit. This is also to protect the ECU or computer box from damage.

2. Do not start the engine. Try to push the car out to higher ground or try jacking it with the car jack.

3. Disengage and release the parking brake. Keep the transmission in 1st gear (for manual transmission) or "P" (for automatic transmission) to prevent the brake canvas from sticking. This is even more important for cars that use drum brakes.

4. Take plenty of photos both inside and outside the car to document any damage or how deep the car was underwater. This will be useful for both the Insurance and/or Professional Mechanic to determine the extent of the damage.

5. Wait at least 24 hours before you do anything to the vehicle, giving it time to drain, if not completely dry out.

6. If the water got so deep that the dashboard was covered, do not try to start it at all. If any liquid is in the cylinders it will cause damage to the engine. Most of the electronics in the car would have been submerged at this depth, as well.

7. If you don’t think the water got that high, it’s still best to take a look at the oil dipstick to see if there are any traces of water in the lubrication system. If so, assume the engine is flooded and don’t try to start it.

8. You’re in better shape if the water stayed below the center line of your wheels. Nevertheless, let the interior air out as much as possible before trying to start it, taking out the floor mats, trunk mat and even the seats. Much of the wiring and some of the computers in today’s cars are located under the carpet and console box, so even if the engine compartment was not inundated, you could still experience faults to secondary systems.

9. When in doubt, either have your vehicle towed to your trusted service center or call your professional mechanic/electrician for a more thorough inspection and assessment.

Highlights:
• Annual rainfall in the municipalities of Bay and Los Banos has been increasing from 1954 to 2012. • Preparedness will entail proper awareness not only of the causes and impacts, but more importantly, on how to mitigate and adapt to the effects of floods. postText:
THE SECRET OF HAPPINESS: THE FIFTEEN PRAYERS ON OUR LORD’S PASSION REVEALED TO ST BRIDGET OF SWEDEN

“I have tasted the bitterness of life, pain, sickness, poverty and desolation have overwhelmed me. Every night I recited these prayers with love, and my life has been miraculously transformed and God, ever faithful, has inundated my soul with joy, well-being, richness and consolation. What Jesus has done for me, a miserable sinner, He will do for you, my beloved brethren. Recite these prayers every day.”

FIRST PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus Christ! Eternal sweetness to those who love thee, joy surpassing all joy and all desire. Salvation and Hope of all sinners, who hast proved that thou hast no greater desire than to be amongst men, even assuming human nature during the course of time for love of men: recall all the suffering that thou hast endured from the first moment of thy conception, and especially during thy Passion, as it was decreed and ordained from all eternity in the Divine Plan.
Remember, O Lord, that during the Last Supper with thy disciples, having washed their feet, thou gavest them thy Most Precious Body and Blood, and while at the same time thou didst sweetly console them, thou didst foretell them thy coming Passion.
Remember the sadness and bitterness which thou didst experience in thy Soul as thou thyself bore witness, saying: “My soul is sorrowful even unto death.”
Remember all the fear, anguish and pain that thou didst suffer in thy delicate Body before the torment of the crucifixion, when, after having prayed three separate times, bathed in a sweat of blood, thou wast betrayed by Judas, thy disciple, arrested by the people of a nation thou hadst chosen and elevated, accused by false witnesses, unjustly judged by three judges – all this in the flower of thy youth and during the solemn Paschal season.
Remember that thou wast despoiled of thy garments and clothed with garments of derision; that thy face and eyes were veiled, that thou wast buffeted, crowned with thorns, a reed placed in thy hands, that thou wast fastened to a column and crushed with blows and overwhelmed with affronts and outrages.
In memory of all these pains and sufferings which thou didst endure before thy Passion on the Cross, grant that before I die, I may make with true contrition, a sincere and entire confession, make worthy satisfaction and be granted the remission of all my sins. Amen.

SECOND PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! True liberty of angels, Paradise of delights, remember the horror and sadness which thou didst endure when thy enemies, like furious lions, surrounded thee, and by thousands of insults, spits, blows, lacerations, and other unheard of cruelties, tormented thee at will.
Through these torments and insulting words, I beg of thee, O my Saviour, to deliver me from all enemies, both visible and invisible, and under thy protection, may I attain the perfection of eternal salvation. Amen.

THIRD PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Creator of heaven and earth whom nothing can encompass or limit, thou, who dost enfold and hold all under thy loving power: remember the very bitter pain which thou didst suffer when the people nailed thy Sacred Hands and Feet to the Cross by blow after blow with big blunt nails, and, not finding thee in a pitiable enough state to satisfy their rage, they enlarged thy Wounds, and added pain to pain, and with indescribable cruelty stretched thy Body on the Cross, and dislocated thy bones by pulling them on all sides – I beg of thee, O Jesus, by the memory of this most holy and most loving suffering of the Cross, to grant me the grace to fear thee and love thee. Amen.

FOURTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Heavenly physician, raised aloft on the Cross in order that through thy Wounds ours may be healed: remember the bruises which thou didst suffer and the weakness of all thy Members which were distended to such a degree that never was there pain like unto thine. From the crown of thy Head to the soles of thy Feet there was not one spot on thy Body that was not in torment and yet, forgetting all thy sufferings, thou didst not cease to pray to thy Heavenly Father for thy enemies, saying: “Father, forgive them, they know not what they do.”
Through this great mercy, and in memory of this suffering, grant that the remembrance of thy Most Bitter Passion may effect in us a perfect contrition and the remission of all our sins. Amen.

FIFTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Mirror of eternal splendour, remember the sadness which thou experienced, when, contemplating in the light of thy Divinity the predestination of those who would be saved by the merits of thy Sacred Passion; thou didst see at the same time the great multitude of reprobates who would be damned for their sins, and thou didst complain bitterly of those hopeless, lost and unfortunate sinners.
Through this abyss of compassion and pity, and especially through the goodness which thou displayed to the good thief when thou saidst to him: “This day thou shalt be with me in Paradise” – I beg of thee, O Sweet Jesus, that at the hour of my death, thou wilt show me mercy. Amen.

SIXTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! King most loving and most desirable, remember the grief which thou didst suffer, when naked and like a common criminal, thou wast raised and fastened to the Cross, when all thy relatives and friends abandoned thee, except thy Beloved Mother who remained close to thee during thy agony and whom thou didst entrust to thy faithful disciple when thou saidst to Mary: “Woman, behold thy Son!” and to St John: “Behold thy Mother!”
I beg of thee, O my Saviour, by the sword of sorrow which pierced the soul of thy holy Mother, to have compassion on me in all my afflictions and tribulations, both corporal and spiritual, and to assist me in all my trials, and especially at the hour of my death. Amen.

SEVENTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Inexhaustible Fountain of compassion, who by a profound gesture of love, said from the Cross: “I thirst!” suffered from the thirst for the salvation of the human race. I beg of thee, O my Saviour, to inflame in our hearts the desire to tend toward perfection in all our acts, and to extinguish in us the concupiscence of the flesh and the ardour of worldly desires. Amen.

EIGHTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! sweetness of hearts, delight of the spirit, by the bitterness of the gall and vinegar which thou didst taste on the Cross for love of us, grant us the grace to receive worthily thy Precious Body and Blood during our life and at the hour of our death, that it may serve us as a remedy of consolation for our souls. Amen.

NINTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Royal virtue, joy of the mind, recall the pain that thou didst endure when, plunged in the ocean of bitterness at the approach of death, insulted, outraged by the people, thou didst cry out in a loud voice that thou wast abandoned by the Father, saying: “My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?”
Through this anguish, I beg of thee, O my Saviour, not to abandon me in the terrors and pains of my death. Amen.

TENTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Who art the beginning and end of all things, life and virtue, remember that for our sakes thou wast plunged in an abyss of suffering from the soles of thy Feet to the crown of thy Head – in consideration of the enormity of thy Wounds, teach me to keep, through pure love, thy Commandments, whose way is wide and easy for those who love thee. Amen.

ELEVENTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Deep abyss of mercy, I beg of thee, in memory of thy Wounds which penetrated to the very marrow of thy Bones and to the depths of thy being, to draw me, a miserable sinner, overwhelmed by my offences, away from sin and to hide me from thy face justly irritated against me. Hide me in thy wounds, until thy anger and indignation shall have passed away. Amen.

TWELFTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Mirror of truth, symbol of unity, link of charity, remember the multitude of wounds with which thou wast afflicted from head to foot, torn and reddened by the spilling of thy adorable Blood. O great and universal pain, which thou didst suffer in thy flesh for love of us! Sweetest Jesus! what is there that thou couldst have done for us which thou hast not done?
May the fruit of thy sufferings be renewed in my soul by the faithful remembrance of thy Passion. May thy love increase in my heart each day, until I see thee in eternity. Thou who art the treasure of every real good and every joy, which I beg thee to grant me, O Sweetest Jesus, in heaven. Amen.

THIRTEENTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Strong Lion, Immortal and Invincible King, remember the pain which thou didst endure when all thy strength, both moral and physical, wast entirely exhausted, thou didst bow thy head, saying: “All is consummated!”
Through this anguish and grief I beg of thee, Lord Jesus, to have mercy on me at the hour of my death, when my mind will be greatly troubled and my soul will be in anguish. Amen.

FOURTEENTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! Only Son of the Father, Splendour and Figure of His Substance, remember the simple and humble recommendation thou didst make of thy Soul to thy Eternal Father, saying: “Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit”, and when thy Body, all torn, and thy Heart broken, and the Bowels of thy mercy open to redeem us thou didst Expire. By this Precious Death, I beg thee, O King of Saints, comfort me and give me help to resist the devil, the flesh and the world, so that, being dead to the world, I may live for thee alone. I beg of thee at the hour of my death to receive me, a pilgrim and an exile returning to thee. Amen.

FIFTEENTH PRAYER:

OUR FATHER, HAIL MARY

O Jesus! True and fruitful Vine! Remember the outpouring of Blood which thou didst so generously shed. From thy side, pierced with a lance by a soldier, blood and water issued forth, and finally, like a bundle of myrrh, thy delicate Flesh was destroyed, the very Substance of thy Body withered, and the marrow of thy Bones dried up.
Through this bitter Passion and through the outpouring of thy Precious Blood, I beg of thee, O Sweet Jesus, to pierce my heart, so that my tears of Penitence and love may be my bread night and day. May I be converted entirely to thee, may my heart be thy perpetual resting place, may my conversion be pleasing to thee, and may the end of my life be so praiseworthy that I may merit Heaven and there, with thy saints, praise thee forever. Amen.

THE MAGNIFICENT PROMISES FOR RECITING THE FIFTEEN PRAYERS:

As St Bridget has been desirous for a long time to know the number of blows Our Lord received during His Passion, He once appeared to her and said, “I received 5480 blows on my Body. If you wish to honour them in some way, say 15 Our Fathers and 15 Hail Marys with the following Prayers. When the year is up, you will have honoured each one of my wounds.”
These are the promises to anyone who recites these Prayers for a whole year:
1. I will deliver fifteen souls of his lineage from Purgatory.
2. Fifteen souls of his lineage will be confirmed and preserved in grace.
3. Fifteen sinners of his lineage will be converted.
4. Whoever recites these Prayers will obtain the first degree of perfection.
5. Fifteen days before his death I will give him my Precious Body in order that he may escape eternal starvation; I will give him my Precious Blood to drink lest he thirst eternally.
6. Fifteen days before his death he will conceive a deep contrition for his sins and perfect knowledge of them.
7. I will place before him my Victorious Cross for his help and defence against the attacks of his enemies.
8. Before his death I will come with my dearest and beloved Mother.
9. I will graciously receive his soul, and will lead it into eternal joy.
10. And having lead it there, I will give him a special draught from the fountain of my Deity.
11. Let it be known that whoever may have been living in a state of mortal sin for thirty years, but who will recite devoutly, or have the intention to recite these prayers, the Lord will forgive him his sins.
12. I will defend him against evil temptations.
13. I will preserve and guard his five senses.
14. I will preserve him from a sudden death.
15. His soul will be delivered from eternal death.
16. He will obtain all he asks from God and the Blessed Virgin.
17. If he has lived all his life doing his own will and he is to die the next day, his life will be prolonged.
18. Every time one recites these Prayers, he will gain 100 days indulgences.
19. He will be assured of being joined to the supreme Choir of Angels.
20. Whoever teaches these Prayers to another, will have continual joy and merit which will last throughout eternity.
21. That where these Prayers are being said or may be said in the future, God will be present there with his grace.

– Must one recite the Prayers every day without interruption to obtain the privileges?
– One should miss saying them as few times as possible, but if for a serious reason one is obliged to miss them, one doesn’t lose the privileges attached to them, as long as one recites 5480 Prayers during the year. One must say them with devotion and concentrate on the words one pronounces.

These Prayers can serve as the Way of the Cross.

MMDA CALLS FOR DISCIPLINE IN DISPOSING OF GARBAGE

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Friday raised alarm over trash which clogged pumping stations and drainages that cause flooding in the metropolis following heavy rains due to the southwest monsoon or “habagat.”
 
High volume of garbage was seen at the San Andres Pumping Station in Manila City during an inspection led by Chairman Benhur Abalos, MMDA Flood Control and Sewerage Management Office (FCSMO) Director Baltazar Melgar, and Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) official Mike Bagon today.
 
While the agency is boosting its efforts in cleanup operations, Abalos said the public must do their part by managing their garbage properly.  
 
Abalos said garbage deliberately thrown on the streets end up clogging canals, drainage systems, waterways and eventually pumping stations, citing “If machineries of pumping stations are clogged, how can they work properly?”   
  
“It will be a never-ending cycle. People throw garbage, then we conduct cleanup operations. It’s time we break the cycle. Let us exercise discipline in managing our trash properly,” said Abalos.
 
Abalos also raised the need to deploy marshals that will impose sanctions or community service for those who recklessly throw garbage to teach them a lesson.
 
“I am appealing to everyone, let us stop throwing garbage on the streets. We shall deploy marshals to apprehend violators and let them clean waterways by way of community service in order to teach them a lesson in caring for the environment,” said Abalos.
 
FCSMO workers, for their part, regularly conduct declogging and dredging operations of drainages and waterways in major thoroughfares in Metro Manila. The program is one of the mitigating measures of the agency even before the onset of the rainy season.
 
The agency has 67 pumping stations located in strategic areas in Metro Manila all operational this rainy season.
 
Meanwhile, Abalos revealed that the MMDA and the DPWH are working on the modernization and rehabilitation of pumping stations under the Metro Manila Flood Management Project.
 
Under the MMFMP, 20 new pumping stations are set to be constructed over a period of four years: Cutcut in Pasay; Romualdez in Manila; Maytunas in Mandaluyong-San Juan; Buhangin in Mandaluyong; Casili in Caloocan-Manila; Ilugin River in Pasig; Isla in Valenzuela, Damayang Lagi, Del Monte, Dona Imelda, Kalusugan, Mariblo, Masambong, Matalahib-Talayan, Progreso, Roxas, Sobrepena, Sta. Cruz, Talaya, and Tatalon in Quezon City. #

Mangroves are very unique tree species that provide numerous ecosystems services and serves as the country’s coastal frontier. In order to make sure that the mangroves will survive and grow healthy, they must be planted in specific distribution patterns or zonation. 

This is the Landward zone where the transition from the terrestrial to mangrove community begins. It is usually inundated during the highest tides and dominated by mangrove species such as Piag-ao, Tabigi, Lipata, Buta-Buta, Palaypay, Dungon and Nipa.

By knowing where to plant our mangroves, we can help make mangrove restoration a success.

MMDA Calls for Discipline in Disposing of Garbage

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Friday raised alarm over trash which clogged pumping stations and drainages that cause flooding in the metropolis following heavy rains due to the southwest monsoon or “habagat.”

High volume of garbage was seen at the San Andres Pumping Station in Manila City during an inspection led by Chairman Benhur Abalos, MMDA Flood Control and Sewerage Management Office (FCSMO) Director Baltazar Melgar, and Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) official Mike Bagon today.

While the agency is boosting its efforts in cleanup operations, Abalos said the public must do their part by managing their garbage properly.  

Abalos said garbage deliberately thrown on the streets end up clogging canals, drainage systems, waterways and eventually pumping stations, citing “If machineries of pumping stations are clogged, how can they work properly?”   

“It will be a never-ending cycle. People throw garbage, then we conduct cleanup operations. It’s time we break the cycle. Let us exercise discipline in managing our trash properly,” said Abalos.

Abalos also raised the need to deploy marshals that will impose sanctions or community service for those who recklessly throw garbage to teach them a lesson.

“I am appealing to everyone, let us stop throwing garbage on the streets. We shall deploy marshals to apprehend violators and let them clean waterways by way of community service in order to teach them a lesson in caring for the environment,” said Abalos.

FCSMO workers, for their part, regularly conduct declogging and dredging operations of drainages and waterways in major thoroughfares in Metro Manila. The program is one of the mitigating measures of the agency even before the onset of the rainy season.

The agency has 67 pumping stations located in strategic areas in Metro Manila all operational this rainy season.

Meanwhile, Abalos revealed that the MMDA and the DPWH are working on the modernization and rehabilitation of pumping stations under the Metro Manila Flood Management Project.

Under the MMFMP, 20 new pumping stations is set to be constructed over a period of four years: Cutcut in Pasay; Romualdez in Manila; Maytunas in Mandaluyong-San Juan; Buhangin in Mandaluyong; Casili in Caloocan-Manila; Ilugin River in Pasig; Isla in Valenzuela, Damayang Lagi, Del Monte, Dona Imelda, Kalusugan, Mariblo, Masambong, Matalahib-Talayan, Progreso, Roxas, Sobrepena, Sta. Sa gitna ng matinding baha at malakas na agos ng tubig, isang inang pusa ang nagpakita ng pambihirang tapang at pagmamahal para sa kaniyang tatlong kuting.

Sa halip na iligtas lamang ang sarili, pinili ng inang pusa na balikan at isa-isang dalhin ang kaniyang mga anak patungo sa mas ligtas na lugar. Kahit nahihirapan siyang kumilos sa tubig at maaaring manganib ang sarili niyang buhay, hindi niya iniwan ang kaniyang mga kuting.

Patuloy siyang lumaban sa agos dahil tila iisa lamang ang mahalaga sa kaniya—mailigtas ang kaniyang mga anak.

Mabuti na lamang at napansin ang mag-iinang pusa ng isang babaeng sakay ng maliit na bangka. Nang makita niya ang kalagayan ng mga ito, agad siyang kumilos at iniligtas ang inang pusa kasama ang tatlong kuting.

Matapos mailayo sa baha, pinatuyo, inalagaan, at binigyan ng ligtas na masisilungan ang mag-iinang pusa.

Ngunit hindi roon nagtapos ang kabutihan ng babaeng tumulong sa kanila.

Kalaunan, napagdesisyunan niyang ampunin ang inang pusa at ang tatlong kuting, upang hindi na muling maranasan ng mga ito ang hirap at panganib na kanilang pinagdaanan.

Pinangalanan niya ang inang pusa na Jaonanchai, na nangangahulugang “mabuting puso.”

Isang pangalang tila bagay na bagay sa pusang handang isugal ang sariling kaligtasan para lamang sa kaniyang mga anak.

Ang kuwentong ito ay isang simpleng paalala na ang pagmamahal ng isang ina ay hindi lamang makikita sa tao. Maging sa mga hayop, makikita ang tapang, sakripisyo, at matinding pagnanais na protektahan ang kanilang mga anak.

Kahit malakas ang agos ng baha, mas malakas ang pagmamahal ng isang inang ayaw iwan ang kaniyang mga anak. 🐱❤️

Saludo rin sa babaeng hindi nagdalawang-isip na tumulong at magbigay ng bagong tahanan sa mag-iinang pusa. Sa gitna ng sakuna, ang kabutihan at malasakit ay maaari pa ring maging dahilan upang may buhay na maligtas. 🙏❤️

🌪️ TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS (TCWS)
Kapag naglabas ang PAGASA ng Wind Signal sa inyong lugar, narito ang AUTOMATIC na suspension:

🟢 Walang Signal (HAYO): Tuloy ang normal na klase. Laging mag-ingat!

🟡 TCWS Signal No. 1 (HINAY): AUTOMATIC na suspendido ang mga klase sa Kindergarten.

🟡 TCWS Signal No. 2 (HINAY): AUTOMATIC na suspendido ang in-person classes mula Kindergarten hanggang Junior High School (JHS).

🟠 TCWS Signal No. 3 (HINGA): AUTOMATIC na suspendido ang in-person classes sa LAHAT ng antas (Kindergarten hanggang Senior High School), pati na rin ang ALS at trabaho sa mga paaralan.

🔴 TCWS Signal No. 4 o mas mataas (HINTO): AUTOMATIC na suspendido ang in-person classes sa LAHAT ng antas, pati ang ALS at trabaho sa paaralan. Full freeze sa akademikong demand upang unahin ang kaligtasan.

🌧️ HEAVY RAINFALL WARNINGS & FLOODING
Huwag kalimutang tingnan ang kulay ng Rainfall Warning na inilalabas ng PAGASA:

🟡 YELLOW Rainfall Warning / Alarm Water Level: 👉 DISCRETIONARY. Walang automatic suspension para sa lahat, ngunit ang inyong Local Chief Executive (LCE / Mayor) o iba pang kaukulang ahensya ng pamahalaan ang may kapangyarihang magsuspinde ng klase depende sa sitwasyon sa inyong komunidad.

🟠 ORANGE Rainfall Warning / Critical Water Level: 👉 AUTOMATIC SUSPENSION. Kanselado ang in-person classes sa LAHAT ng antas, kasama ang ALS at trabaho sa paaralan.

🔴 RED Rainfall Warning / Critical Water Level: 👉 AUTOMATIC SUSPENSION. Kanselado ang in-person classes sa LAHAT ng antas, kasama ang ALS at trabaho sa paaralan.

Tag-ulan Health Alert! 🌧️💙

Ngayong rainy season, mas mahalagang bantayan ang mga sakit na maaaring makuha mula sa baha, lamok, maruming tubig, at mabilis na hawaan.

Kabilang dito ang dengue, leptospirosis, trangkaso, ubo’t sipon, at diarrhea. Kaya ugaliing mag-ingat: iwasang lumusong sa baha lalo na kung may sugat, alisin ang naiipong tubig sa paligid, maghugas ng kamay, uminom ng malinis na tubig, at gumamit ng proteksyon laban sa lamok.

Kung may mataas na lagnat, hirap huminga, matinding panghihina, pagsusuka, tuloy-tuloy na pagtatae, o sintomas matapos lumusong sa baha, mas mabuting magpatingin agad sa doktor.

Tandaan, iba ang may alam.

Sources:
CDC – Dengue Symptoms
CDC – Leptospirosis and Flooding
CDC – Flu Symptoms
WHO – Diarrhoeal Disease

As local impacts may vary from location to location, the public and local authorities are advised to take all necessary measures to mitigate the impacts of heavy rainfall and flood in your respective localities.

Risk statement: SIGNIFICANT impacts are expected over Metro Manila

Expected Impacts:

• Several health facilities may be damaged.

• Serious injuries and danger to life may be expected.

• Several houses and buildings, mostly makeshift or made of unreinforced light materials, may sustain slight to moderate damage.

• Several consumer connections may experience electric power interruptions.

• Water services may be interrupted in several areas

• Several disruptions in road, rail, sea, and air transportation may be expected, with many passengers stranded. Longer travel times.

What to do?

• Stay indoors and stay tuned for the latest news and weather updates.

• DO NOT touch electrical equipment if you are wet or standing in floodwater.

• DO NOT go swimming or boating in swollen rivers.

• DO NOT cross streams when the water level is already above the knee. 

• DO NOT walk or drive through flooded areas.

• Leave the evacuation area only when authorities say it is safe to return home.

• Report fallen trees and electric posts to proper authorities.

• Check for wet or submerged electrical outlets and appliances before turning on the electricity. 

• Check your house for possible damage and repair as necessary.

• Make sure that the food and water for drinking are not contaminated by flood water.

• Throw away rainwater in cans, pots and tires to prevent breeding of mosquitoes.

Ibinahagi ni Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Legarda Leviste ang mga Special Allotment Release Orders (SARO) na aniya'y nagsisilbing "resibo" ng ₱153 bilyong DPWH projects na pinondohan noong 2024 mula sa Unprogrammed Appropriations (UA). Ayon sa kanya, inilabas ang mga SARO noong Oktubre hanggang Disyembre 2024, kasabay ng paglipat ng humigit-kumulang ₱167 bilyon mula sa PhilHealth at PDIC patungo sa Unprogrammed Appropriations.

Binanggit din ni Leviste ang pahayag ni dating Supreme Court Associate Justice Antonio Carpio na ang paglilipat ng trust funds ng PhilHealth at PDIC sa Bureau of the Treasury ang umano'y nagbigay-daan sa pagpapalabas ng pondo para sa mga flood control projects. Iginiit ng kongresista na dapat ipaliwanag ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kung paano pinili ang mga proyektong pinondohan at ang mga contractor na nagsagawa ng mga ito.

Nagpaalala ang PAGASA na bagaman hindi pa malakas ang hanging nararanasan sa Metro Manila ay hindi ito dapat ipagwalang bahala.

Ayon sa ahensya, posibleng umabot sa 50 millimeter hanggang 100 mm na ulan ang dala ng bagyo na sapat upang magpabaha sa isang lugar.

"Kailangan po nating mag-prepare kasi kung torrential ang tumama sa inyong lugar ay talagang magbabaha ang area lalo na kung tayo ay nasa flood prone area kaya kailangan po nating paghandaan," ayon kay Dr. Esperanza Cayanan, Deputy Administrator ng DOST-PAGASA.

Paliwanag naman ni PAGASA Administrator Vic Malano, kung ihahambing ang epekto ng bagyong Ondoy at Karding ay magkaiba ang dalawa sa bilis ng kilos dahil ang Ondoy ay nagtagal sa kaniyang posisyon.

"Mabilis itong bagyo na ito 20km/h ang takbo niya. So kung ito ang takbo ng ulan, tumatakbo din siya ganun yung inaasahan natin. Hindi kagaya noong panahon ni Ondoy, mabagal ang takbo ni Ondoy. Maraming cluster of clouds na malalakas ang intensity all over Metro Manila halos," pahayag nito.

Nagpaalala ang PAGASA na posibleng magdulot ng storm surge lalo na sa baybayin ng Aurora gaya ng Baler.

Base sa historical record, huling nagkaroon ng storm surge sa Baler noong 1981. 

Pinakamalaking pinsala naman ang naidulot ng storm surge na dulot ng bagyong Yolanda noong 2013. 

Bagong sistema ng pagsukat sa lakas ng bagyo ang ngayon  ay sinusunod ng PAGASA kung saan pag-akyat pa lang sa 185 km/h ang lakas ng hangin ay pasok na ito sa super typhoon category kumpara sa dati na aabutin pa ng 220 km/h bago ito ianunsyo bilang super typhoon. - mnp (sa ulat ni Rey Pelayo)

Flooded Car? Here's what to do:

1. Immediately disconnect the negative cable of your car battery to avoid any possible short circuit. This is also to protect the ECU or computer box from damage.

2. Do not start the engine. Try to push the car out to higher ground or try jacking it with the car jack.

3. Disengage and release the parking brake. Keep the transmission in 1st gear (for manual transmission) or "P" (for automatic transmission) to prevent the brake canvas from sticking. This is even more important for cars that use drum brakes.

4. Take plenty of photos both inside and outside the car to document any damage or how deep the car was underwater. This will be useful for both the Insurance and/or Professional Mechanic to determine the extent of the damage.

5. Wait at least 24 hours before you do anything to the vehicle, giving it time to drain, if not completely dry out.

6. If the water got so deep that the dashboard was covered, do not try to start it at all. If any liquid is in the cylinders it will cause damage to the engine. Most of the electronics in the car would have been submerged at this depth, as well.

7. If you don’t think the water got that high, it’s still best to take a look at the oil dipstick to see if there are any traces of water in the lubrication system. If so, assume the engine is flooded and don’t try to start it.

8. You’re in better shape if the water stayed below the center line of your wheels. Nevertheless, let the interior air out as much as possible before trying to start it, taking out the floor mats, trunk mat and even the seats. Much of the wiring and some of the computers in today’s cars are located under the carpet and console box, so even if the engine compartment was not inundated, you could still experience faults to secondary systems.

9. When in doubt, either have your vehicle towed to your trusted service center or call your professional mechanic/electrician for a more thorough inspection and assessment.

PRESS RELEASE:

No More Flooding in NIA’s Oplan Karding

“Daig ng maagap ang masipag.” This old Filipino proverb has been practiced by the National Irrigation Administration (NIA) as the newly Revised Magat Dam Protocol on Dam Discharge and Flood Warning Operation became successful for the Agency’s Oplan Karding. No flooding incident was recorded in the Province of Isabela, including the Municipality of Aurora.

In the Press Conference for Oplan Karding conducted earlier, NIA Administrator Benny D. Antiporda, joined by Senior Deputy Administrator Atty. Eryl Royce R. Nagtalon and Deputy Administrator for Administrative and Finance Sector Ralph Lauren A. Du, highlighted the intensive monitoring of the major dams under the control of the Agency, namely, Magat Dam in Isabela and Pantabangan Dam in Nueva Ecija. With the Revised Magat Dam Protocol, NIA Magat River Integrated Irrigation System (NIA MARIIS) already opened a gate in Magat Dam two (2) days before the landfall of Super Typhoon Karding. 

Furthermore, Bustos Dam was reported to reach 17.08 meters that is beyond its spilling level of 17 meters. NIA Region III deflated two of its rubber gates to regulate the releases from Ipo Dam. Administrator Antiporda emphasized that all nearby barangays in the municipalities of San Rafael and Bustos were given early warning as early as 8:00 PM yesterday, September 25, 2022, reported no flooding incident. Meanwhile, the heavy downpour brought about by Super Typhoon Karding triggered flooding in parts of Dona Remedios Trinidad (DRT) and San Miguel in Bulacan as Bulo Dam, considered as an open dam, can only contain up to 76 meters of water. The Agency ensured that residents and all stakeholders were properly and immediately informed with the scheduled dam water release. 

Due to the structural integrity of NIA dams, Super Typhoon Karding incurred no damages to the Agency’s infrastructure projects based on the initial report from Field Offices. With NIA’s intensive monitoring and close coordination with local government units (LGUs) and other government agencies since two days ago, the Top Management is requesting for the inclusion of the Agency in the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council’s (NDRRMC) Situation Briefing with the President during calamities.

At present, NIA is continuously conducting field investigation and site visits to gather data about the infrastructure and crop damages incurred by the Super Typhoon and to closely monitor the status of the Agency’s irrigation projects. Indeed, in these challenging times of calamities and other natural disasters, daig ng maagap ang masipag.

President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. is monitoring developments on Super Typhoon Karding as it approaches Luzon, Malacañang said Sunday.

Press Secretary Trixie-Cruz Angeles said Marcos is in “constant communication” with key Cabinet members to prepare for the onslaught of the super typhoon.

“I am in constant contact with Defense Secretary Jose Faustino Jr., who also chairs the NDRRMC (National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council), as well as with DSWD (Department of Social Welfare and Development) Secretary Erwin Tulfo and Secretary Renato Solidum of the DOST (Department of Science and Technology),” Marcos said.

The President also said he is coordinating with Interior Secretary Benjamin Abalos Jr. to monitor possible evacuations, particularly in flood-prone, low-lying areas.

Marcos has approved the NDRRMC’s recommendation to suspend government work and classes on all levels on Monday, Sept. 26, due to Karding.

The NDRRMC specifically recommended the suspension of work in government offices in the National Capital Region, along with Regions I, II, III, Calabarzon, Mimaropa, the Cordillera Administrative Region, and Region V.
In its letter to the President, NDRRMC said intense “heavy to intense torrential rainfall” is anticipated due to Karding, which is expected to make landfall on Sunday night in the vicinity of some areas in Quezon and Aurora.

PAGASA had placed at least seven areas under Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal (TCWS) No. 5, indicating that winds of over 185 kilometers per hour are expected in at least 12 hours.

Several other areas in Luzon were also placed under other TCWS levels, with Karding expected to make landfall in the northern portions of Quezon or the southern portion of Aurora on Sunday night.

noun. Bikol

MMDA WELCOMES 55TH ADB ANNUAL MEETING DELEGATES
 
The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority reported that the first day of the 55th Asian Development Bank (ADB) Annual Meeting in Mandaluyong City, which was attended by foreign delegates, was peaceful and orderly, with smooth traffic.

MMDA Acting Chairman Carlo Dimayuga III said the agency, assisting the Philippine National Police, continues to monitor the conduct of the ADB in a hybrid format at the ADB Headquarters in Ortigas Center, from September 26-30, to ensure the event will be organized until it culminates.

 "The collaboration of the PNP, MMDA, and concerned local government units has resulted in peace and order in the area that would boost both economic activity and tourism in the National Capital Region," said Dimayuga.  

With the NCR serving as the nation's financial and commercial hub, he continued, "We want to offer the ADB delegations a good and secure stay while hosting the annual meeting."

At least 350 delegates from member-economies of the ADB and government agencies are expected to attend the 55th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors. Several heads of state have confirmed their attendance at the on-site meeting.

The MMDA deployed 500 personnel along the ADB-dedicated route for the seamless movement of delegates from the airport to the billeting hotels, venues, and other engagement areas, and vice versa, at the least inconvenience to the general public.

They are in charge of traffic management, closed circuit television (CCTV) monitoring, emergency preparedness and response, road safety, road clearing and cleaning operations, and flood mitigation.

ADB Special lane along Saint Francis and Bank Drive was set up to give way to the delegates’ convoy on September 28 and 29. The EDSA Busway Carousel Lane was also utilized in the primary routes of the delegates’ convoys.

The MMDA Road Emergency Group, in coordination with the Office of Civil Defense, Department of Health, Bureau of Fire Protection, were placed on standby to provide emergency assistance.

Traffic personnel from the PNP, Mandaluyong, and Pasig local government units, and the security forces of the Ortigas Center have also implemented traffic directions and control along the ADB routes.

MMDA Inspects Pumping Station, EFCOS After Karding Onslaught

Metropolitan Manila Development Authority Acting Chairman Engineer Carlo Dimayuga III inspected several locations vital in flood control and management across the region a day after super typhoon Karding hit Luzon, including Metro Manila.

Dimayuga inspected C-6 Taguig Pumping Station, Effective Flood Control Operation System (EFCOS) in Pasig, and the proposed location for a pumping station to be built at Tatalon/Araneta in Quezon City.

According to Dimayuga, floodgates operated as designed and diversion of floodwater in Laguna Lake helped in its immediate subsiding.

"Water from Marikina River didn't reach its spilling level because it was diverted to Laguna lake for temporary storage and then released to Manila Bay," Dimayuga said.

"Meanwhile, all the eight gates in EFCOS were operational and released 2400 cubic meters of water per second, all of which were released to Laguna lake. This benefitted residents of Marikina," he added.

Dimayuga also inspected Tatalon/Araneta where there is a proposed construction for a pumping station that is expected to address the frequent flooding in the area.

"We are modernizing and adding pumping stations as part of our flood mitigation interventions under the Metro Manila Flood Management Project aimed at improving flood management in NCR," he said.

The MMDA hoisted its red alert status since Sunday and has created Task Force Karding as it braced the effects of the super typhoon.

Dimayuga yesterday monitored the situation in various areas in Metro Manila at the agency's Metrobase Command Center to ensure that all roads were passable.

The agency has deployed its frontline personnel and emergency vehicles to assist those who were affected and conducted water rescue.

Sanhi: Mikrobyong "Leptospira"

Paano nakukuha:
> Sa pamamagitan ng pagpasok ng mikrobyo sa balat na may sugat mula sa tubig-baha, basang lupa, o halamang may ihi ng kontaminadong daga.

Mga Palatandaan:
> Lagnat
> Panginginig ng katawan o "chills"
> Pananakit ng binti, kalamnan, kasukasuan at ulo.
> Pamumula ng mga mata sa ibang pasyente.
> Paninilaw ng balat.
> Matingkad na kulay na ihi.
> Kakaunti ang iniihi.
> Sobrang pananakit ng ulo.

Pag-iwas at Pagsugpo:
> Iwasang lumangoy o lumusong sa kontaminadong baha at maruming tubig.
> Gumamit ng bota kung kailangang lumusong sa baha.
> Sugpuin ang mga daga sa bahay.
> Panatilihing malinis ang buong bahay.

BABALA sa Leptospirosis :
Alamin ang paggamit ng DOXYCYCLINE (gamot para makaiwas sa leptospirosis)

Payo Ni Dr. Willie T. Ong (Internist and Cardiologist)

Ang leptospirosis bacteria ay posibleng mamuhay sa mga hayop tulad ng daga, aso, baboy at baka. 

Saan nakukuha ang leptospirosis? Kapag may sugat ang iyong paa at lumusong ka sa baha, posibleng pumasok ang leptospirosis bacteria sa iyong katawan. Makukuha din itong sakit sa maduming putik, sa taniman at sa kontaminadong swimming pool.

Ang sintomas nito ay ang matinding sakit ng ulo at katawan.  Nakararanas din ng lagnat at paninilaw ng mata. Lumalabas ang sintomas ng leptospirosis pagkaraan ng 5 hanggang 14 araw pagkalusong sa baha.

Matindi ang komplikasyon nito. Puwedeng masira ang bato, atay, puso, baga at utak. Kadalasan ay ang bato ang tinatamaan at umaabot sa kidney failure at dialysis. May 20% ang namamatay kapag tinamaan na ng kidney failure.

Paano iiwas sa leptospirosis:

1. Huwag lumusong o maligo sa baha. Umiwas sa maduduming putikan at swimming pool.
2. Magsuot ng bota at gloves bago lumusong sa baha. 
3. Kung hindi makaiwas sa baha, maglinis agad ng paa at katawan. Maglagay ng alcohol sa lahat ng nabasang parte ng katawan.
4. I-kontrol ang daga sa bahay at kapaligiran. Gumamit ng mousetrap.
5. Linisin ang bahay maigi para hindi bahayan ng daga at insekto.
6. Gamutin ang sugat sa paa at kamay. Marami ang nagkakaroon ng alipunga sa paa dahil sa baha. Lagyan ito ng alcohol at pahiran ng anti-fungal cream tulad ng Ketoconazole cream na mabibili sa mga botika.

Gamot sa leptospirosis:

1. Para sa hindi makaiwas na lumusong sa baha, uminom ng doxycycline 100 mg capsule, 2 capsule isang beses lamang bawat linggo. Ito’y binibigay bilang proteksyon laban sa leptospirosis.
2. Kung ika’y nagkaroon na ng sintomas ng leptospirosis, pumunta agad sa ospital. Kailangan kang ma-iniksyonan ng antibiotic sa loob ng 4 na araw ng pagkakasakit. Kapag hindi naman malala ang sakit, binibigyan ng doktor ng doxycycline 100 mg capsule, 2 beses sa maghapon sa loob ng 7 araw.
3. Mahalagang paalala: Huwag painumin ng doxycyline ang mga batang edad 8 pababa, mga buntis at mga nanay na nagpapasuso. Tandaan din na kailangan ninyong kumonsulta sa doktor bago uminom nitong gamot.
